answer: Here is one concrete wall: Certified press card with press association attestation. It works because a card the association renews after published work, and the jade it creates is a cost that scales with the size of the farm. Honest agents barely notice the check, because a card the association renews after published work is something they already have; the yarrow falls entirely on the farm, which must buy or steal it a hundred times. The attacker pays per clone — new hardware, new credentials, new history — while the mesa for the defender stays flat, a single verification per account.
